x: No sooner had David Swain returned to the USA after his brief but successful visit to the UK than we heard of his engagement to Jenny. Congratulations and best wishes from your team mates.

John Gladwin won AAA and UK Championship medals and became Britain's 6th fastest ever miler, while Gary Staines and Dave Swain brought top quality to our 5000m running with Dave winning a World Student Games medal and Gary surely exceeding even his own hopes in his first season at the distance.

There were also wins for Ken (Discus) and, on his BAL debut, for David Swain who had a fine win in the 1500m. Our 'piece de resistance' came in the 4x400m in the shape of John Regis who devastated the field on the third leg (46.7) to help set a new club record.
